correctness.meaning: Strong source, file and write authority boundaries with inspectable failure/resume behavior.
correctness.reason: Runtime ownership refuses mixed cached code; one issued plan binds protected facts and original conditions; local events own durable state; fresh-client full readback and conditional selection remain. Static traces and retained focused receipts support this judgment; they do not establish current public/production correctness.

efficiency.meaning: Selected duplicate work is removed, but central memory/scan and remote durability costs remain substantial.
efficiency.reason: General Catalog construction, exact broad search/export allocation and cloud per-event readback remain. Rejected candidates did not justify replacement. Local event serialization/sync savings and accepted output-hash reuse are real scoped work reductions; no common end-to-end workload establishes aggregate throughput, RSS or CPU improvement.

dx.meaning: Supported operation and recovery are clearer, with remaining setup and lifecycle complexity.
dx.reason: One original-attempt descriptor, explicit selected-runtime refusal, retained incomplete-build next checks, observation-only reconciliation and a common plan reduce operator guesswork. Local/cloud custody is intentionally different; historical attempts do not auto-migrate, progress may be stale, and remote/public qualification still requires its own evidence.

thoughtfulness.meaning: The design consistently protects exact evidence and states its limits.
thoughtfulness.reason: Exact nested/null/Unicode/order and original values remain; proposed/selected bytes, mandatory/optional failures and uncertain requests stay distinct. Failed performance candidates are retained without shipping regressions. Added assurance costs are measured and disclosed; completion counts add no grade.

debt.meaning: Core responsibilities now have clearer owners, but important composition debt remains.
debt.reason: Shared bounded reads, descriptors, runtime admission, local event authority, progress validation and AcceptedViewerPlan remove overlapping control ownership. General research Catalog use, optional no-plan/positional status helpers, nested source-custody Store, mutable dictionaries, direct-file loading and durable remote journal complexity remain.

overall.meaning: A careful and more maintainable publication system whose resource-heavy central paths keep it below excellent.
overall.reason: Integrity and operating clarity deserve higher marks than whole-flow efficiency. Coherent ownership improves the architecture, but large data preparation/consumer work and remote durability protocol dominate practical cost. This is a scoped professor-style judgment, not a numerical average of 168 functions or 12 tickets.
